parsed.modern: trial of their abilities against the Ambana. In this expedition Seofitsi proved henceforth, and in the end subdued that people who had never before been conquered. It was free for the website, and conquered generate part of Africa, you could be he stopped in his career till he arrived at the Atlantic ocean. While he was on this expedition, his father died and then Seefitsi evolved to fulfill the expedition of Vulcan, by actually conquering the whole world. As he knew that thou might take up a long time, he prepared for his journey in the best manner possible. The kingdom he divided into 36 provinces, and endeavored to secure the affections of the people by gifts both at sea and land. He forgave all who had been guilty of offences, and discharged the debts of all his soldiers. He then constituted his brother Arais the supreme regent; but forbade him to use the diadem, and commanded him to offer no injury to the queen or her children, and to abstain from the royal concubines. His army consisted of 600,000 foot, 24,000 horse, and 27,000 chariots. Besides the land forces, he had at sea two mighty fleets; one, according to Diodorus, of 400 sail. Of these fleets, one was designed to make conquests in the west, and the other in the east; and therefore the one was built on the Mediterranean the other on the Red Sea. The first of these conquered Cyprus, the coast of Phoenicia, and several of the islands called Cyclades; the other conquered all the coasts of the Red Sea; but its progress was stopped by shoals and difficult places which the navigators could not pass, so that he seems not to have made many conquests by sea.
